research_question: Does a first-party CALIS/PKU public classical-book portal authenticate any of the seven secondary Xu-An 1599 holder leads and expose a free original juan45 leaf?

firstparty_routes.observation: Official PKU site explicitly links 秘籍琳琅 and 學苑汲古 as separate ancient-book catalog and image discovery paths; it describes PKU古籍 entries as separate from modern catalog.

Official 學苑汲古 landing text describes generally public access to university classical book metadata and images and states individual library records are not de-duplicated. During this anonymous web-retrieval observation the platform text included 系统接口501异常, and no title-specific query result returned.
Official PKU link lands on a JavaScript loading shell in current text-only retrieval; this is not evidence of item absence or general public inaccessibility.
Official PKU link to 秘籍琳琅 timed out in this retrieval environment; no anonymous search result or verified original image was acquired.

limits: Platform-level public availability does not establish access to the exact Xu-An volume or an individual original-page image.
CALIS description explicitly says records are not deduplicated; results cannot be counted as independent physical copies without object/edition/copy evidence.
System interface 501 and JS shell are this retrieval's access limits, not whole-service outage or absence of 古今律曆考.
No account, payment, bypass, speculative query endpoint or repeat generic email was used.
No source registry entry, edition-level relation, physical witness count or G893 numerical adjudication is supported.
next_action: Use only first-party exact-title item-level results with stable shelfmark, original-juan45 mapping and lawful anonymous image retrieval; otherwise return to other verified original-source routes without treating the CALIS platform as a new witness.

unproven: No platform metadata route can be promoted into historical source-glyph testimony or copy/edition transmission.
